analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (KRW 32,395) vs SMA5 (KRW 30,537) / SMA20 (KRW 35,711) / SMA50 (KRW 44,518) — below short-term trend, below mid-term trend
· Position relative to SMA100 (KRW 40,986) / SMA200 (KRW 31,695) — below long-term trend, above very long-term trend
· 52-week position (46.5%) + current price level at historical midpoint
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (32.9 → 42.1) — exiting oversold, attempting to enter neutral zone
· MACD histogram trajectory (-655.6557 → -91.8217) — improving, weak convergence continues
· Bollinger Band current price position (mid-band KRW 35,711) — trading near mid-band
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (KRW 29,075) — based on Pivot S1 (KRW 23,550) and SMA200 (KRW 31,695)
· Swing resistance (KRW 35,220) — below Pivot R1 (KRW 42,745)
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low / Lower High / Sideways) — 5-day high 34370, 20-day high 44250 lower. Sideways range.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.78x) — decreased confidence in movement
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation) — wait for directional confirmation
